summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: iShares Future AI Beneficiaries ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to track the Morningstar US Artificial Intelligence Beneficiaries Select Index. The fund invests in U.S. companies that may benefit from the adoption of artificial intelligence, primarily through cost savings and additionally through revenue growth and amplification. The ETF began operations on September 22, 2026 and is listed on NYSE Arca under the ticker AIBF.
